svg.title: Context manager: committing one turn
svg.desc: Execution ownership precedes turn mutation, and final writes still verify version and deadline. reject returns busy; queue waits. Memory extraction may continue in the background. Check save/flush results: generation completion does not prove persistence or memory success.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Trusted scope: objectId + sessionId"] B["Check local concurrency; acquire shared execution ownership"] C["Read current context; prepare messages and token budget"] D["Retrieve / compress as configured; call the model"] E["Commit turn with version and deadline checks"] F["Return generation result; check save / flush as needed"] X["Busy, cancelled, conflicted or expired: reject stale commit"] A --> B B --> C C --> D D --> E E --> F B -->|"not available"| X E -->|"ownership no longer valid"| X classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class F good; class X stop;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif
